summary: OpenAI announced GPT-5.4 mini and nano, smaller and faster versions of GPT-5.4 optimized for coding, tool use, multimodal reasoning, and high-volume API and sub-agent workloads.

mechanisms.reason: Smaller, faster model variants typically reduce per-token serving cost compared to the full-size model.
